openers.prompt_en: A school learning app shows 12,04,000 video views. Read this number using lakh.
openers.prompt_hi: School learning app par 12,04,000 video views dikh rahe hain. Is number ko lakh mein kaise padhoge?
hints: Which digits are in the lakh group?
Read each comma-separated group from left to right.
The groups read ___ lakh, four thousand.
Twelve lakh four thousand: the first group shows twelve lakh.

openers.prompt_en: A music platform reports 3 million downloads of an Indian song. How many lakh downloads is that?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek music platform kehta hai ki Indian song ke 3 million downloads hue. Yeh kitne lakh downloads hain?
hints: How are a million and a lakh related?
Convert one million first, then scale up.
For three million, multiply the lakh value by ___ .
30 lakh: each million equals ten lakh.

harder.prompt_en: A science video reached eight crore six lakh seventy thousand nine views. Write the view count in numerals with Indian commas.
harder.prompt_hi: Ek science video ko aath crore chhah lakh sattar hazaar nau views mile. Views ka number Indian commas ke saath likho.
hints: Which place-value groups are mentioned?
Keep the crore, lakh, thousand and ones groups separate.
Fill missing digits: 8,__,70,00_.
8,06,70,009: the lakh group is six, and the ones digit is nine.

harder.prompt_en: A game company reports 0.75 billion downloads worldwide. Express this count in crores.
harder.prompt_hi: Ek game company worldwide 0.75 billion downloads batati hai. Is count ko crore mein batao.
hints: How many crores make one billion?
Take three-quarters of that crore count.
In crores, calculate 0.75 × ___ .
75 crore: one billion is 100 crore, and 0.75 × 100 = 75.

harder.prompt_en: Two city events sold 4,09,80,000 and 4,10,02,000 tickets. Which sold more—Event A (4,09,80,000) or Event B (4,10,02,000)—and which place-value group decides it?
harder.prompt_hi: Do city events ke 4,09,80,000 aur 4,10,02,000 tickets bike. Zyada kisne beche—Event A ya Event B—and kaunsa place-value group faisla karta hai?
acceptable: Event B, because its lakh group is larger
hints: At which group do the counts first differ?
Compare groups from the left, beginning with crores.
Both have the same crore group; compare the ___ groups.
Event B; its lakh group is larger after equal crore groups.

openers.prompt_en: A school has registered 12,468 students for an exam. For printing one answer sheet per student, should it use 12,468 or about 12,000?
openers.prompt_hi: School mein exam ke liye 12,468 students registered hain. Har student ke liye ek answer sheet print karni hai. 12,468 use karoge ya lagbhag 12,000?
hints: What happens if some students have no sheet?
Each registered student needs their own sheet.
Print for the ___ count, not a rounded count.
12,468. Rounding down could leave students without sheets.

openers.prompt_en: A music video got 3,26,400 views. Round this to the nearest lakh for a quick announcement.
openers.prompt_hi: Ek music video ko 3,26,400 views mile. Jaldi announcement ke liye ise sabse paas ke lakh tak round karo.
hints: Which two whole lakhs is the count between?
Check how far it has gone beyond the lower lakh.
To the nearest lakh, the view count is ___.
3 lakh views. It is closer to 3 lakh than 4 lakh.

harder.prompt_en: A kabaddi tournament sold 18,736 tickets. A poster says ‘about 19,000 fans came’. Should the treasurer use 18,736 or about 19,000 to check ticket payments, and why?
harder.prompt_hi: Kabaddi tournament ke 18,736 tickets bike. Poster par ‘lagbhag 19,000 fans aaye’ likha hai. Ticket payments check karne ke liye treasurer 18,736 use kare ya lagbhag 19,000? Kyun?
harder.answer: 18,736, because checking payments needs the exact number of tickets sold
acceptable: 18,736; payments need the exact ticket count
18736, because every ticket payment must be accounted for
hints: Could a rounded count hide unpaid or missing tickets?
The poster and payment check serve different purposes.
For payments, use ___ because every sale matters.
18,736. The treasurer must account for every ticket sold.

verified.solverAnswer: 18,736, because exact count is needed for payments

harder.prompt_en: A game had 8,64,20,000 downloads across India. Round this count to the nearest crore for a headline.
harder.prompt_hi: India bhar mein ek game ke 8,64,20,000 downloads hue. Headline ke liye is count ko sabse paas ke crore tak round karo.
hints: Which two whole crores surround this count?
Look at the part beyond the completed crores.
The nearest whole-crore count is ___.
9 crore downloads. The count is closer to 9 crore.

harder.prompt_en: A news headline rounds 4,76,40,000 app downloads to 5 crore. By how many downloads does the headline differ from the actual count?
harder.prompt_hi: News headline mein 4,76,40,000 app downloads ko 5 crore likha hai. Headline ka count actual count se kitne downloads alag hai?
hints: Is the headline count above or below the actual count?
Find the gap between the rounded and actual counts.
Gap = headline count − actual count = ___.

openers.prompt_en: A school prints 2,000 tickets for each of 30 event sessions. How many tickets does it print in all?
openers.prompt_hi: School har event session ke liye 2,000 tickets print karta hai. 30 sessions ke liye kul kitne tickets print honge?
hints: Which parts of both numbers are not zeros?
Multiply those parts, then account for the ending zeros.
Tickets = 2 × 3, followed by ___ zeros.
60,000 tickets: 2 × 3 is 6, with four ending zeros.

openers.prompt_en: A metro train carries 798 passengers per trip and makes 21 trips. Round each number to its highest place, then estimate the total passengers.
openers.prompt_hi: Ek metro train har trip mein 798 passengers le jaati hai aur 21 trips karti hai. Dono numbers ko highest place tak round karke total passengers ka andaaza lagao.
hints: What are the highest places in the two numbers?
Round each number there before multiplying.
Estimated passengers = ___ × ___.
About 16,000 passengers: 800 × 20 gives that estimate.

harder.prompt_en: A game awards 4,500 points for each completed challenge. A team completes 60 challenges. What is its total score?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek game mein har completed challenge par 4,500 points milte hain. Team 60 challenges complete karti hai. Uska total score kya hai?
hints: Can you separate the ending zeros from the other digits?
Multiply the remaining parts, then restore the zeros.
Total points = (45 × 6) followed by ___ zeros.
2,70,000 points: 45 × 6 is 270, then add three zeros.

harder.prompt_en: A concert hall has 198 rows with 49 seats each. For an estimate, should Meera use 200 × 50 or 200 × 100? Choose one and say why.
harder.prompt_hi: Concert hall mein 198 rows hain, har row mein 49 seats. Estimate ke liye Meera 200 × 50 use kare ya 200 × 100? Ek chuno aur wajah batao.
hints: Which option keeps the seats per row closer to the actual number?
A useful estimate rounds numbers without changing their size too much.
Choose 200 × ___ because 49 is closer to ___.
200 × 50: 49 is close to 50, not 100.

verified.solverAnswer: 200 × 50, because 49 rounds to 50, which is much closer than 100.

harder.prompt_en: A phone-data report multiplies 32 by 10⁴ to convert a count into individual units. Without writing the full product, how many digits will it have?
harder.prompt_hi: Phone-data report mein count ko individual units mein badalne ke liye 32 ko 10⁴ se multiply kiya gaya. Poora product likhe bina batao, usmein kitne digits honge?
hints: What does the exponent tell you about the power of ten?
Multiplying a whole number by that power adds ending zeros.
Digit count = digits in 32 + ___.
6 digits: 32 has two digits, and 10⁴ adds four zeros.

ongrade.prompt_en: A school orders 240 boxes of notebooks, with 3,000 notebooks in each box. How many notebooks does it order?
ongrade.prompt_hi: Ek school 240 notebooks ke boxes order karta hai. Har box mein 3,000 notebooks hain. Kul kitni notebooks order hui?
hints: Which parts can you multiply before dealing with the zeros?
Multiply the non-zero parts, then account for both sets of zeros.
24 × 3 = ___; now account for the zeros.
7,20,000 notebooks: 240 × 3,000 gives 72 followed by four zeros.

ongrade.prompt_en: A cricket club sells 6,180 tickets at ₹480 each. Estimate its ticket collection by rounding 6,180 to the nearest thousand and ₹480 to the nearest hundred.
ongrade.prompt_hi: Ek cricket club 6,180 tickets ₹480 mein bechta hai. 6,180 ko nearest thousand aur ₹480 ko nearest hundred round karke ticket collection ka andaaza lagao.
hints: What do the two numbers become at the requested places?
Round first; multiply the rounded numbers, not the original ones.
The estimate is ___ × ___ = ___.

ongrade.prompt_en: A calculation is (8 × 10⁵) × (15 × 10²). Without writing the full product, how many digits will the answer have?
ongrade.prompt_hi: Ek calculation hai (8 × 10⁵) × (15 × 10²). Poora product likhe bina batao, answer mein kitne digits honge?
hints: What happens to the powers of 10 when you multiply?
Multiply the small factors and combine the powers of 10.
10 digits: the product is 120 followed by seven zeros.

openers.prompt_en: A metro card costs ₹200 to buy, and each ride costs ₹18. Write an expression for the total cost of the card and 5 rides.
openers.prompt_hi: Metro card kharidne ke ₹200 lagte hain, aur har ride ₹18 ki hai. Card aur 5 rides ki total cost ka expression likho.
hints: Which cost is paid once, and which repeats?
Multiply the ride cost by the number of rides, then add the card cost.
Total cost = card cost + ___ × ride cost.
200 + 5 × 18; the card is bought once, and five rides are paid for.

openers.prompt_en: In a game, Riya earns 75 points in each of 4 rounds but loses 30 points for each of 2 penalties. Write an expression for her final score.
openers.prompt_hi: Ek game mein Riya 4 rounds mein har round 75 points leti hai, lekin 2 penalties par har baar 30 points khoti hai. Final score ka expression likho.
hints: How would you represent points earned across all rounds?
Find total points earned and total points lost separately.
Final score = ___ × 75 − 2 × 30.
4 × 75 − 2 × 30; subtract both penalties from the round points.

harder.prompt_en: Six friends put ₹150 each into a fund. They pay one group entry fee of ₹120 and share the remaining money equally. Write an expression for each friend’s share.
harder.prompt_hi: Chhe dost ek fund mein ₹150 each daalte hain. Group ki ek entry fee ₹120 dete hain, phir bache paise equally baantte hain. Har dost ke share ka expression likho.
hints: What amount is available before the entry fee is paid?
Subtract the group fee before dividing the remainder.
Each share = (___ − group fee) ÷ number of friends.
(6 × 150 − 120) ÷ 6; divide only after paying the group fee.

harder.prompt_en: Without calculating their values, which is greater: A = 76 × (48 − 19) or B = 76 × 48 − 76 × 20? Answer A or B.
harder.prompt_hi: Values poore calculate kiye bina batao, kaunsa bada hai: A = 76 × (48 − 19) ya B = 76 × 48 − 76 × 20? A ya B bolo.
hints: Can you rewrite one expression in the other’s form?
Use multiplication over subtraction to compare matching parts.
A = 76 × 48 − 76 × ___; now compare the amounts subtracted.
A; it subtracts 76 × 19 rather than the larger 76 × 20.

harder.prompt_en: Which situation matches (240 − 3 × 40) ÷ 4? A: Four friends share ₹240 after buying three ₹40 tickets together. B: Each friend gets ₹240 and buys three ₹40 tickets. C: Four friends share ₹240, then each pays ₹40 three times.
harder.prompt_hi: Kaunsi situation (240 − 3 × 40) ÷ 4 se match karti hai? A: Chaar dost ₹240 mein se teen ₹40 tickets saath kharidkar bache paise baantte hain. B: Har dost ko ₹240 milte hain aur woh teen tickets kharidta hai. C: Chaar dost ₹240 baantkar har ek teen baar ₹40 deta hai.
acceptable: Four friends share what remains after buying three ₹40 tickets together
hints: What happens before the division?
The subtraction concerns one shared amount, not each person’s money.
First the group pays for ___ tickets; then the remainder is shared.
A; the group buys three tickets before four friends split the remainder.

openers.prompt_en: A school-fair stall writes its earnings as ₹80 × 4 + ₹50 × 3 − ₹60. How many terms does this expression have?
openers.prompt_hi: School fair ke stall ki kamai ₹80 × 4 + ₹50 × 3 − ₹60 likhi hai. Is expression mein kitne terms hain?
hints: Which signs separate the main parts of the expression?
Multiplication stays inside a term; addition and subtraction separate terms.
3 terms; the plus and minus signs separate them.

openers.prompt_en: A phone has 5 GB of data. A game uses 2 × 0.5 GB, and videos use 1 GB. How much data remains? Calculate 5 − 2 × 0.5 − 1.
openers.prompt_hi: Phone mein 5 GB data hai. Game 2 × 0.5 GB aur videos 1 GB use karte hain. Kitna data bachega? 5 − 2 × 0.5 − 1 calculate karo.
hints: Which calculation belongs inside one term?
Find the game’s total use before subtracting data used.
Data left = 5 − ___ − 1 GB.
3 GB; the game uses 1 GB, and videos use 1 GB.

harder.prompt_en: For a school trip, 24 students each pay ₹75. The bus costs ₹1,250 and entry tickets cost ₹15 per student. How much money is left? Use 24 × 75 − 1,250 − 24 × 15.
harder.prompt_hi: School trip ke liye 24 students ₹75 each dete hain. Bus ₹1,250 aur entry ticket ₹15 per student hai. Kitne paise bachenge? 24 × 75 − 1,250 − 24 × 15 use karo.
hints: Which amounts must you calculate before subtracting?
Treat each multiplication as one term.
₹190; subtract both costs from ₹1,800 collected.

harder.prompt_en: A metro card has ₹300. A ₹40 fare and ₹25 fee are deducted together: 300 − (40 + 25). Which gives the same balance: 300 − 40 − 25 or 300 − 40 + 25?
harder.prompt_hi: Metro card mein ₹300 hain. ₹40 fare aur ₹25 fee saath mein deduct hote hain: 300 − (40 + 25). Same balance kaunsa dega: 300 − 40 − 25 ya 300 − 40 + 25?
hints: Are both amounts inside the brackets being deducted?
A minus before brackets changes the sign of each enclosed term.
Removing the brackets gives 300 − 40 ___ 25.
300 − 40 − 25; both charges are deducted.

harder.prompt_en: A cricket team’s score changes by +38, −27, +62 and −13 runs across four updates. Starting from 100, what is the final score? Group positive and negative terms smartly.
harder.prompt_hi: Cricket team ka score chaar updates mein +38, −27, +62 aur −13 runs se badalta hai. 100 se shuru karke final score kya hoga? Positive aur negative terms ko smartly group karo.
hints: Which signed changes pair neatly?
Keep each minus sign attached when rearranging terms.
160 runs; the gains total 100 and the losses total 40.

openers.prompt_en: A cricket stump is marked every 10 cm. A mark is 30 cm above the ground. What fraction and decimal of a metre is its height?
openers.prompt_hi: Cricket stump par har 10 cm par nishaan hai. Ek nishaan zameen se 30 cm upar hai. Uski height metre ke fraction aur decimal mein kya hogi?
hints: How many 10 cm parts reach the mark?
A metre contains ten parts of 10 cm each.
The mark reaches ___ tenths of a metre.
3/10 m = 0.3 m; the mark is three tenths up.

openers.prompt_en: On a 1 m poster, the school logo begins 7 cm from the left edge. Write that distance as a fraction and a decimal of a metre.
openers.prompt_hi: 1 m ke poster par school logo left edge se 7 cm door shuru hota hai. Yeh doori metre ke fraction aur decimal mein likho.
hints: How many centimetres make one metre?
Each centimetre is one hundredth of a metre.
The distance is ___ hundredths of a metre.
7/100 m = 0.07 m; seven centimetres are seven hundredths.

harder.prompt_en: A kabaddi court line is 1.6 m from the centre line. How many tenths of a metre is that distance?
harder.prompt_hi: Kabaddi court ki ek line centre line se 1.6 m door hai. Yeh doori metre ke kitne tenths hai?
hints: How many tenths are in the whole metre?
Count the whole metre and the extra tenths together.
Total tenths = tenths in the whole metre + ___.
16 tenths; ten tenths plus six tenths.

harder.prompt_en: A school stage is 2.35 m wide. Write only the part beyond 2 m as a fraction of a metre with denominator 100.
harder.prompt_hi: School stage 2.35 m chaurā hai. Sirf 2 m se aage wala hissa, metre ke fraction mein denominator 100 ke saath likho.
hints: Which digits show the part beyond the whole metres?
The two decimal places represent hundredths.
The fractional part is ___/100 m.
35/100 m; the decimal part has thirty-five hundredths.

harder.prompt_en: At sports day, Meera jumps 2 m 9 cm and Sana jumps 2.12 m. Who jumps farther: Meera or Sana?
harder.prompt_hi: Sports day par Meera 2 m 9 cm jump karti hai aur Sana 2.12 m. Zyada door kaun jump karti hai: Meera ya Sana?
hints: Can you compare both jumps in metres?
Centimetres become hundredths when written in metres.
Meera’s jump is 2.__ m; compare it with Sana’s.
Sana; Meera’s 2.09 m is shorter than 2.12 m.

openers.prompt_en: A bag of rice weighs 3.46 kg. What is the value of the digit 4 in kilograms?
openers.prompt_hi: Chawal ka ek bag 3.46 kg ka hai. Ismein digit 4 ki value kilograms mein kya hai?
hints: Which place is immediately after the decimal point?
A digit there counts tenths of a kilogram.
The value of 4 is ___ kg.
0.4 kg; the 4 is in the tenths place.

openers.prompt_en: A game download uses 2 GB + 5/10 GB + 7/100 GB of data. Write the total as a decimal in GB.
openers.prompt_hi: Ek game download mein 2 GB + 5/10 GB + 7/100 GB data lagta hai. Total ko decimal mein GB mein likho.
hints: Which digits belong after the decimal point?
Put tenths first and hundredths second.
The total is 2.__ GB.
2.57 GB; 5 is tenths and 7 is hundredths.

harder.prompt_en: A lab report shows 9.04 mL, but a student copies it as 9.4 mL. Why does leaving out the zero change the measurement?
harder.prompt_hi: Lab report mein 9.04 mL hai, par ek student 9.4 mL likhta hai. Zero hatane se measurement kyun badal jaati hai?
harder.answer: The 4 moves from the hundredths place to the tenths place.
acceptable: The zero holds the tenths place, so removing it changes the value of 4
hints: Where is the 4 in each measurement?
The zero keeps a place between the point and 4.
Without the zero, 4 moves to the ___ place.
The 4 moves from hundredths to tenths, making its value greater.

verified.solverAnswer: The zero holds the tenths place; without it, 4 shifts to tenths.

harder.prompt_en: A school fundraiser records ₹25 + ₹7/100 + ₹3/1000 from one digital payment. Write the amount as a decimal in rupees.
harder.prompt_hi: School fundraiser mein ek digital payment ₹25 + ₹7/100 + ₹3/1000 record hoti hai. Amount ko rupees mein decimal ke roop mein likho.
acceptable: twenty-five point zero seven three rupees
hints: Which place is missing between the whole rupees and hundredths?
Keep a zero in any missing decimal place.
After the point, write ___, then 7, then 3.
₹25.073; the tenths place needs a zero.

harder.prompt_en: A train app says a trip took 2 hours 30 minutes. Another display says 2.30 hours as a decimal. Which duration is longer: 2 hours 30 minutes or 2.30 decimal hours?
harder.prompt_hi: Train app par trip 2 hours 30 minutes ki hai. Doosri display par decimal mein 2.30 hours hai. Kaunsi duration zyada hai: 2 hours 30 minutes ya 2.30 decimal hours?
hints: Does the point in decimal hours separate hours from minutes?
Convert the decimal part using minutes in one hour.
The decimal display is 2 hours ___ minutes.
2 hours 30 minutes; 2.30 decimal hours is only 2 hours 18 minutes.

openers.prompt_en: A number line from 4.30 km to 4.40 km is split into 10 equal parts. A cyclist has covered 4.36 km. How many small steps after 4.30 km should you mark the cyclist?
openers.prompt_hi: 4.30 km se 4.40 km ki number line ko 10 barabar hisson mein baanta hai. Cyclist ne 4.36 km tay kiye. 4.30 km ke baad use kitne chhote steps par mark karoge?
hints: Each small step adds how much distance?
Compare the hundredths digits at the start and at the cyclist’s position.
The cyclist’s mark is ___ small steps after the start.
6 steps: each step adds 0.01 km to 4.30 km.

openers.prompt_en: Two stationery shops sell the same pen for ₹18.07 and ₹18.70. Which price is lower?
openers.prompt_hi: Do stationery shops mein wahi pen ₹18.07 aur ₹18.70 ka hai. Kaunsi price kam hai?
hints: Are the whole-rupee amounts different?
When whole numbers match, compare digits after the point from left to right.
The lower price has ___ in the tenths place.
₹18.07 is lower: its tenths digit is smaller.

harder.prompt_en: On a number line, 5.82 m to 5.83 m is split into 10 equal parts. A long-jump mark is at the seventh small tick after 5.82 m. What distance does it show?
harder.prompt_hi: Number line par 5.82 m se 5.83 m tak 10 barabar hisse hain. Long jump ka mark 5.82 m ke baad saatve chhote tick par hai. Distance kya hai?
acceptable: five point eight two seven metres
hints: What is the total gap between the endpoints?
Divide that gap equally before counting ticks.
Each tick adds 0.001 m; the marked distance is 5.82 + ___.
5.827 m: seven ticks add 0.007 m.

harder.prompt_en: Three runners finish in 11.095 s, 11.15 s and 11.105 s. Which time wins the race?
harder.prompt_hi: Teen runners 11.095 s, 11.15 s aur 11.105 s mein finish karte hain. Kaunsa time race jeetega?
acceptable: eleven point zero nine five seconds
hints: Does a race winner take more time or less time?
Add trailing zeros if needed, then compare digits place by place.
The winning time is the smallest: ___ s.
11.095 s wins: it is less than both other times.

harder.prompt_en: A game leaderboard shows scores of 2.307 and 2.308. Give one decimal score strictly between them.
harder.prompt_hi: Game leaderboard par scores 2.307 aur 2.308 hain. In dono ke beech ka ek decimal score batao, jo kisi endpoint ke barabar na ho.
acceptable: any decimal strictly greater than 2.307 and less than 2.308
hints: Could an extra decimal place fit between these scores?
Write both scores to four decimal places.
Choose a score greater than the lower endpoint but below ___ .
2.3075 works: it is greater than 2.307 and less than 2.308.

openers.prompt_en: A phone download uses 1.08 GB in the morning and 0.7 GB in the evening. How much data does it use altogether?
openers.prompt_hi: Phone par subah 1.08 GB aur shaam ko 0.7 GB data download hua. Kul kitna data use hua?
hints: Which place values need to line up?
Write both amounts with their decimal points aligned.
1.78 GB; aligned tenths and hundredths add correctly.

openers.prompt_en: A ribbon is 5 m long. Meera cuts off 1.25 m for a school display. How much ribbon remains?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek ribbon 5 m lambi hai. Meera school display ke liye 1.25 m kaat leti hai. Kitni ribbon bachi?
hints: How will you write the whole metres in decimal places?
Use empty decimal places, then trade while subtracting.
3.75 m; writing 5.00 makes the trading clear.

harder.prompt_en: For a school event, three teams collect 12.375 kg, 8.6 kg and 0.85 kg of paper for recycling. What is the total mass?
harder.prompt_hi: School event mein teen teams ne recycling ke liye 12.375 kg, 8.6 kg aur 0.85 kg paper jama kiya. Kul mass kitna hai?
acceptable: twenty-one point eight two five kilograms
ikkees point aath do paanch kg
hints: Where should the decimal points go in your columns?
Keep thousandths, hundredths and tenths in their own columns.
21.825 kg; adding aligned place values gives the total.

harder.prompt_en: A runner's goal is 10 km. She runs 3.875 km before school and 2.4 km after school. How much farther must she run?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek runner ka goal 10 km hai. Woh school se pehle 3.875 km aur school ke baad 2.4 km daudti hai. Ab aur kitna daudna hai?
acceptable: three point seven two five kilometres
teen point saat do paanch km
hints: How far has she run altogether?
Add the runs first, then subtract from the goal.
3.725 km; subtract her total distance from the goal.

harder.prompt_en: A cricket scoreboard shows 18.95 + 7.1 = 26.05. Without calculating the exact sum again, which estimate checks it better: about 26 or about 35?
harder.prompt_hi: Cricket scoreboard par 18.95 + 7.1 = 26.05 likha hai. Exact sum dobara kiye bina, kaunsa andaaza behtar check hai: lagbhag 26 ya lagbhag 35?
hints: What whole numbers are the two amounts close to?
Round each amount, then add the rounded numbers.
The rounded-number sum is about ___.
About 26; the amounts round to 19 and 7.

openers.prompt_en: In a game, your score before a bonus is k. The screen shows your new score as k + 15. What does k stand for?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek game mein bonus se pehle tumhara score k hai. Screen par naya score k + 15 dikh raha hai. Yahan k kya batata hai?
acceptable: bonus milne se pehle ka score
hints: Which score could change each time you play?
The letter names a number before an operation happens.
k is the score before the ___ is added.
k is the score before the bonus; 15 is added to it.

openers.prompt_en: At a school event, one entry ticket costs ₹12. An online order also has a single ₹8 booking fee. Write the total cost of buying x tickets.
openers.prompt_hi: School event ka ek entry ticket ₹12 ka hai. Online order par ek baar ₹8 booking fee bhi lagti hai. x tickets ki total cost ka expression likho.
hints: Which charge depends on the number of tickets?
Multiply the ticket price by the count, then include the one-time fee.
Total cost = 12 × ___ + 8.
₹(12x + 8): tickets cost ₹12x, plus one ₹8 fee.

harder.prompt_en: In kabaddi practice, Meera earns 3 points for each successful raid. Her raid points are written as 3m. If she earns 24 raid points, what value does m have?
harder.prompt_hi: Kabaddi practice mein Meera ko har successful raid par 3 points milte hain. Uske raid points 3m likhe hain. Agar use 24 raid points mile, toh m ki value kya hai?
hints: What does the letter count in this situation?
Find how many equal groups of points make the total.
m = total raid points ÷ ___.
m = 8 raids, because 24 ÷ 3 = 8.

harder.prompt_en: For a class trip, each student pays ₹40 for entry and ₹15 for a snack. The group also pays one ₹100 booking fee. Write the total cost for n students.
harder.prompt_hi: Class trip mein har student entry ke ₹40 aur snack ke ₹15 deta hai. Group ek baar ₹100 booking fee bhi deta hai. n students ki total cost ka expression likho.
hints: Which costs repeat for every student?
Combine the per-student costs before adding the group fee.
₹(55n + 100): ₹55 per student, plus one ₹100 fee.

harder.prompt_en: Which situation matches 8p − 12 stickers? A: p packets with 8 stickers each, then 12 stickers given away. B: p packets with 8 stickers each, then 12 added. C: p packets with 8 stickers each, then 12 given away from every packet.
harder.prompt_hi: 8p − 12 stickers se kaunsi situation match karti hai? A: p packets mein 8-8 stickers, phir 12 stickers de diye. B: p packets mein 8-8 stickers, phir 12 aur mile. C: har packet se 12 stickers de diye.
acceptable: A: 12 stickers given away in total
hints: Does the subtraction happen once or for every packet?
Read the multiplication first, then the single subtraction.
First count the packet stickers; then ___ stickers are removed overall.
A: 8p counts all packet stickers, then 12 are given away.

openers.prompt_en: A metro card has ₹50. One ride costs ₹r, and the card is charged for 2 rides. If r = 18, how much money remains? Use 50 − 2r.
openers.prompt_hi: Metro card mein ₹50 hain. Ek ride ka kiraya ₹r hai, aur card se 2 rides ka paisa katta hai. Agar r = 18 hai, toh kitne paise bachenge? 50 − 2r use karo.
hints: What does 2r represent here?
Replace r with the ride fare before subtracting.
Money left = 50 − 2 × ___
₹14; two rides cost ₹36, which is subtracted from ₹50.

openers.prompt_en: A school event needs 4b badges for teams, 3b for volunteers, and has b badges left over. Simplify 4b + 3b − b.
openers.prompt_hi: School event mein teams ke liye 4b badges, volunteers ke liye 3b badges chahiye, aur b badges bach jaate hain. 4b + 3b − b simplify karo.
hints: Do all three terms have the same letter?
Combine their number parts; keep the letter.
The result is (___ + ___ − ___)b.
6b; combining the coefficients gives 4 + 3 − 1 = 6.

harder.prompt_en: In a game, one round scores 2a − b points. Riya plays 3 rounds and earns b bonus points. Find 3(2a − b) + b when a = 8 and b = 5.
harder.prompt_hi: Ek game mein ek round ka score 2a − b points hai. Riya 3 rounds khelti hai aur b bonus points paati hai. a = 8 aur b = 5 par 3(2a − b) + b nikaalo.
hints: Which part gives the score for one round?
Substitute inside the brackets before multiplying by three.
38 points; each round gives 11, then add the 5-point bonus.

harder.prompt_en: A scoreboard shows 8p − 3q − 2p + 5q. Which is its simplified form: 6p + 2q or 8p? Give the key reason.
harder.prompt_hi: Scoreboard par 8p − 3q − 2p + 5q likha hai. Iska simplified form kaunsa hai: 6p + 2q ya 8p? Mukhya wajah bhi batao.
acceptable: 6p + 2q, because p and q terms combine separately
6p + 2q; p aur q waale terms alag combine hote hain
hints: Which terms have matching letters?
Group p terms and q terms separately.
Write the result as (8 − 2)p + (___ + ___)q.
6p + 2q; only terms with the same letter combine.

harder.prompt_en: A floor design joins hexagonal tiles in a row. The first tile needs 6 border strips; each new tile shares one side, so adds 5 strips. Write a simplified expression for the strips needed for n tiles.
harder.prompt_hi: Floor design mein hexagonal tiles ek line mein jodi jaati hain. Pehli tile ko 6 border strips chahiye; har nayi tile ek side share karti hai, isliye 5 strips aur lagti hain. n tiles ke liye simplified expression likho.
hints: How many tiles come after the first?
Start with the first tile, then count each additional tile.
5n + 1; simplify 6 + 5(n − 1).

openers.prompt_en: A school quiz awards 8 points in round 1, 13 in round 2, and 18 in round 3. If the pattern continues, write a rule for the points awarded in round n.
openers.prompt_hi: School quiz mein round 1 ke 8 points, round 2 ke 13, aur round 3 ke 18 points hain. Pattern aise hi chale, toh round n ke points ka rule likho.
hints: How much do the points increase between rounds?
Use that increase with the round number.
Points in round n = ___ × n + ___.
5n + 3: each round adds 5, starting from 8.

openers.prompt_en: A game gives 6 coins on day 1, 10 on day 2, and 14 on day 3. The daily reward keeps growing by the same amount. How many coins will it give on day 20?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek game day 1 par 6 coins, day 2 par 10, aur day 3 par 14 coins deta hai. Daily reward isi tarah badhta rahe, toh day 20 par kitne coins milenge?
hints: How many increases occur from day 1 to day 20?
Find the fixed increase, then count how often it happens.
Day 20 reward = 6 + ___ × ___.
82 coins: add nineteen increases of 4 to the first reward.

harder.prompt_en: At a school event, row 4 has 19 chairs and row 7 has 31 chairs. Every new row has the same number of extra chairs. Write the rule for chairs in row n.
harder.prompt_hi: School event mein row 4 mein 19 chairs aur row 7 mein 31 chairs hain. Har nayi row mein chairs ki badhotri barabar hai. Row n mein chairs ka rule likho.
hints: How many row-to-row increases lie between rows 4 and 7?
Divide the chair difference by that number of increases.
Chairs in row n = ___ × n + ___.
4n + 3: chairs increase by 4 per row and row 4 has 19.

harder.prompt_en: A fitness app sets weekly step goals using 6n + 4 thousand steps for week n, starting at n = 1. Is 200 thousand steps ever a weekly goal? Answer yes or no.
harder.prompt_hi: Fitness app week n ka step goal 6n + 4 thousand steps rakhta hai, jahan n = 1 se shuru hota hai. Kya 200 thousand steps kabhi weekly goal hoga? Haan ya nahin?
acceptable: no; n is not a whole number
hints: What week number would give the proposed goal?
Work backwards from the goal using the rule.
Required week number = (___ − ___) ÷ ___.
No: (200 − 4) ÷ 6 is not a whole-number week.

harder.prompt_en: A coach adds three consecutive even jersey numbers, such as 12, 14 and 16. Why is their sum always divisible by 6? Let the first number be 2n.
harder.prompt_hi: Coach teen lagataar even jersey numbers jodta hai, jaise 12, 14 aur 16. Unka sum hamesha 6 se divisible kyun hota hai? Pehla number 2n maano.
harder.answer: Their sum is 6(n + 1), which is a multiple of 6.
acceptable: The sum has 6 as a factor
sum 6(n+1) hai, isliye 6 se divisible hai
hints: How can you write the next two even numbers?
Add all three expressions, then collect like terms.
The sum is 6(n + 1), so it has 6 as a factor.

verified.solverAnswer: Sum = 6n + 6 = 6(n + 1), so it is a multiple of 6.

openers.prompt_en: At a school exhibition, a straight ribbon runs from A through O to B. A string from O to C makes angle AOC equal to 68°. What is angle COB?
openers.prompt_hi: School exhibition mein ek seedha ribbon A se O hote hue B tak jaata hai. O se C tak ki string angle AOC 68° banati hai. Angle COB kitna hoga?
hints: What shape do the two angles make together?
Angles beside each other on a straight line form a linear pair.
Missing angle = ___ − 68°.
112°; a linear pair totals 180°.

openers.prompt_en: Two chalk lines cross on a kabaddi court. The angle at the top of the crossing is 74°. What is the angle directly across the crossing, at the bottom?
openers.prompt_hi: Kabaddi court par do chalk lines cross karti hain. Crossing ke upar wala angle 74° hai. Bilkul saamne, neeche wala angle kitna hoga?
hints: Are the top and bottom angles next to each other?
Angles directly across a crossing are vertically opposite.
Bottom angle = ___ angle.
74°; vertically opposite angles are equal.

harder.prompt_en: A straight road has a lane marking that branches at a junction. The two adjacent angles on one side of the road are x° and (2x + 15)°. Find x.
harder.prompt_hi: Ek seedhi road par junction se lane marking alag nikalti hai. Road ki ek taraf bane do paas-paas angles x° aur (2x + 15)° hain. x nikaalo.
hints: What must adjacent angles along a straight road total?
Use the linear-pair total to make an equation.
x + 2x + 15 = ___; then solve.

harder.prompt_en: Two wires cross in a science project. One angle is (3x + 10)° and the angle directly opposite it is (5x − 30)°. What is x?
harder.prompt_hi: Science project mein do wires cross karti hain. Ek angle (3x + 10)° hai aur uske bilkul saamne wala angle (5x − 30)° hai. x kitna hai?
hints: How are angles directly across a crossing related?
Set their two expressions equal.
3x + 10 = ___; then solve for x.
20; both opposite angles become 70°.

harder.prompt_en: Two straight paths cross in a park. The top angle is 127°. Give all four angles in order: top, right, bottom, left.
harder.prompt_hi: Park mein do seedhe paths cross karte hain. Upar wala angle 127° hai. Chaaron angles is order mein batao: upar, daayein, neeche, baayein.
hints: Which angle is directly opposite the top one?
Opposite angles match; neighbouring angles form linear pairs.
Bottom = top; right = ___ − top; left = right.
127°, 53°, 127°, 53°; opposites match and neighbours total 180°.

openers.prompt_en: On a metro map, two straight track lines are 2 cm apart at one station and 2 cm apart at another. They run in the same direction. Are the lines parallel?
openers.prompt_hi: Metro map mein do seedhi track lines ek station par 2 cm aur doosre par bhi 2 cm door hain. Dono ek hi direction mein jaati hain. Kya ye lines parallel hain?
hints: What happens to the gap as you follow the tracks?
Consider both their direction and the distance between them.
Same direction and unchanged gap means the lines are ___.
Yes, they are parallel: their direction and gap stay the same.

openers.prompt_en: Two straight paths across a school ground cross at a marked 90° angle. Are the paths perpendicular?
openers.prompt_hi: School ground mein do seedhe raste 90° ke marked angle par cross karte hain. Kya ye raste perpendicular hain?
hints: What kind of angle is marked where the paths cross?
Think about the angle required for perpendicular lines.
Lines crossing at a right angle are called ___.
Yes, they are perpendicular: they cross at a right angle.

harder.prompt_en: Two straight boundaries of a kabaddi court are 5 m apart at one end and 4.8 m apart at the other. A coach calls them parallel. Is the coach correct? Say why briefly.
harder.prompt_hi: Kabaddi court ki do seedhi boundary lines ek taraf 5 m aur doosri taraf 4.8 m door hain. Coach unhe parallel kehta hai. Kya coach sahi hai? Chhota sa kaaran batao.
acceptable: not parallel because the gap is not constant
hints: Compare the gaps at the two ends.
Parallel lines must stay equally far apart.
Here the gap ___, so the coach is ___.
No; the gap changes, so the boundaries are not parallel.

verified.solverAnswer: No, they are not equidistant everywhere (5 m vs 4.8 m).
verified.note: Both note varying gap means not parallel

harder.prompt_en: At a railway crossing, one angle between two straight tracks is 88°. Are the tracks perpendicular? Answer yes or no.
harder.prompt_hi: Railway crossing par do seedhe tracks ke beech ek angle 88° hai. Kya tracks perpendicular hain? Haan ya nahi bolo.
hints: What angle would a square corner have?
Perpendicular tracks must meet at an exact right angle.
Compare the given angle with ___°.
No; 88° is not a right angle.

harder.prompt_en: You must draw a line perpendicular to a marked line through a marked point. Which set-square action works: align one edge with the line and draw along its adjoining edge, or draw along the same edge?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek marked point se marked line par perpendicular line banani hai. Set-square ka kaunsa tareeka sahi hai: ek edge ko line se milakar uske saath wale edge par draw karo, ya usi edge par draw karo?
harder.answer: Align one edge with the line and draw along its adjoining edge.
acceptable: saath wale edge par draw karo
hints: Which edges of a set-square form its square corner?
Use the two edges that meet at a right angle.
Align one edge; draw along the ___ edge.
Draw along the adjoining edge; it meets the aligned edge at a right angle.

verified.solverAnswer: align one edge with the line and draw along its adjoining edge

openers.prompt_en: Two shelves are crossed by a slanting support. Angle A is above the upper shelf and right of the support. At the lower shelf, angle B is above and right; angle C is below and right. Which corresponds to A: B or C?
openers.prompt_hi: Do shelves ko ek tirchha support cross karta hai. Angle A upar wali shelf ke upar aur support ke right mein hai. Neeche wali shelf par B upar-right aur C neeche-right hai. A ka corresponding angle B hai ya C?
hints: At each crossing, where is the angle compared with both lines?
Corresponding angles occupy matching positions at the two crossings.
A is above-right, so choose the angle in the ___ position.
B: it occupies the same above-right position as A.

openers.prompt_en: Two parallel edges of a school noticeboard are crossed by a diagonal ribbon. An angle and its alternate interior angle are marked. If the first is 58°, what is the marked alternate interior angle?
openers.prompt_hi: School noticeboard ke do parallel edges ko ek diagonal ribbon cross karta hai. Ek angle aur uska alternate interior angle marked hain. Pehla 58° hai; doosra marked angle kitna hoga?
hints: What happens to alternate interior angles when the crossed edges are parallel?
The marked pair has a special equality.
The second angle = ___, using the first angle.
58°: alternate interior angles are equal for parallel edges.

harder.prompt_en: A slanting metro escalator crosses two horizontal floor edges. A is below the upper edge, left of the escalator. At the lower edge, B is above-left, C is above-right, and D is below-right. Which is alternate interior to A: B, C, or D?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek tirchha metro escalator do horizontal floor edges ko cross karta hai. A upper edge ke neeche, escalator ke left hai. Lower edge par B upar-left, C upar-right aur D neeche-right hai. A ka alternate interior angle B, C ya D hai?
hints: Which choices lie between the two floor edges?
Alternate interior angles are inside and on opposite sides of the crossing line.
A is inside-left; its partner must be inside-___.
C: it is inside the edges and right of the escalator.

harder.prompt_en: Two parallel railway tracks are crossed by a straight path. A pair of alternate interior angles measures (3x + 10)° and (5x − 30)°. What is x?
harder.prompt_hi: Do parallel railway tracks ko ek seedha path cross karta hai. Alternate interior angles (3x + 10)° aur (5x − 30)° hain. x kitna hai?
hints: What relationship connects this pair of angles?
Set their two expressions equal, then collect like terms.
3x + 10 = 5x − 30; rearrange to get x = ___.
20: equal alternate interior angles give 3x + 10 = 5x − 30.

harder.prompt_en: A straight cable crosses two stage-light rails. The interior angles on the same side of the cable are 110° and 70°. Are the rails parallel? Answer yes or no, with the angle rule.
harder.prompt_hi: Ek seedhi cable do stage-light rails ko cross karti hai. Cable ke same side par interior angles 110° aur 70° hain. Kya rails parallel hain? Yes ya no bolo, angle rule ke saath.
harder.answer: Yes; same-side interior angles add to 180°.
hints: What sum do same-side interior angles have for parallel lines?
Add the two given angles and compare with a straight angle.
Their sum is ___; use the converse of the co-interior angle rule.
Yes: 110° + 70° = 180°, so the rails are parallel.

verified.solverAnswer: yes, because interior angles on the same side of a transversal are supplementary for parallel lines
verified.note: Both affirm yes with co-interior rule

openers.prompt_en: At a metro station, 246 people are waiting and 135 more join them. Without adding, will the total be odd or even?
openers.prompt_hi: Metro station par 246 log wait kar rahe hain aur 135 aur aa gaye. Bina jode batao, total odd hoga ya even?
hints: What is the parity of each group?
Think about whether either group has one person left unpaired.
The two groups together have ___ person left unpaired.
Odd: only the group of 135 has one person left unpaired.

openers.prompt_en: A school printed 301 event tickets and sold 84. Without subtracting, is the number of unsold tickets odd or even?
openers.prompt_hi: School ne event ke 301 tickets print kiye aur 84 bech diye. Bina subtract kiye batao, bache hue tickets odd hain ya even?
hints: What is the parity of the printed and sold tickets?
Removing a paired number of tickets does not change the leftover parity.
After removing 84 tickets, the unpaired ticket count is ___.
Odd: removing an even number leaves the original unpaired ticket.

harder.prompt_en: A cricket team scored 157 in one match and 89 in another. Without subtracting, is the difference odd or even? Why?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek cricket team ne do matches mein 157 aur 89 runs banaye. Bina subtract kiye, scores ka difference odd hai ya even? Kyun?
harder.answer: Even; subtracting one odd number from another leaves an even number.
acceptable: even, because odd minus odd is even
sam, kyunki odd minus odd even hota hai
hints: What do both scores have in common?
Each score has one run left over after making pairs.
Subtracting their leftover single runs gives ___ unpaired runs.
Even: the single unpaired run in each score cancels out.

verified.solverAnswer: even, because difference of two odd numbers is always even

harder.prompt_en: A gaming tournament has 17 teams. Each team plays 24 rounds and earns 31 points per round. Without multiplying, is the total number of points odd or even?
harder.prompt_hi: Gaming tournament mein 17 teams hain. Har team 24 rounds khelti hai aur har round mein 31 points leti hai. Bina multiply kiye, total points odd honge ya even?
hints: Which factor counts the rounds?
Look for a factor that can be split into pairs.
The product has ___ unpaired points.
Even: the 24 rounds can be paired, so their points can too.

harder.prompt_en: Seven players each score an odd number of points in a kabaddi match. Can their scores total exactly 100? Answer yes or no, and say why.
harder.prompt_hi: Kabaddi match mein saat players mein se har ek ne odd points score kiye. Kya unka total exactly 100 ho sakta hai? Haan ya nahin, aur kyun?
harder.answer: No; the sum of seven odd numbers is odd, but 100 is even.
acceptable: no, seven odd scores add to an odd total
nahin, saat odd scores ka total odd hoga
hints: What happens when you pair up odd scores?
Pairs of odd scores make even totals; check what remains.
After pairing six scores, ___ odd score remains.
No: seven odd scores have an odd total, while 100 is even.

verified.solverAnswer: no, because sum of seven odd numbers is odd

openers.prompt_en: A school puzzle board shows this grid: 9 2 7 / 4 6 8 / 5 10 3. Every row, column and diagonal has the same sum. What is its magic sum?
openers.prompt_hi: School puzzle board par yeh grid hai: 9 2 7 / 4 6 8 / 5 10 3. Har row, column aur diagonal ka sum same hai. Magic sum kya hai?
hints: Which complete line could you add first?
The common total of each line is the magic sum.
Top row ka sum: 9 + 2 + 7 = ___.
18; each row, column and diagonal totals 18.

openers.prompt_en: For a games-club puzzle, complete this magic square with magic sum 45: 18 _ 16 / 13 15 17 / 14 19 12. Which number fills the blank?
openers.prompt_hi: Games club ki puzzle mein magic sum 45 wala square poora karo: 18 _ 16 / 13 15 17 / 14 19 12. Khaali jagah kaunsi sankhya aayegi?
hints: Which line contains the blank?
That line must reach the given magic sum.
Missing number = 45 − 18 − 16 = ___.
11; the top row then totals 45.

harder.prompt_en: A quiz displays 1 5 9 / 6 7 2 / 8 3 4. Every row and column sums to 15. Is it a magic square: yes or no?
harder.prompt_hi: Quiz mein grid hai: 1 5 9 / 6 7 2 / 8 3 4. Har row aur column ka sum 15 hai. Kya yeh magic square hai: yes ya no?
acceptable: no, a diagonal does not sum to 15
hints: Have you checked every required type of line?
Rows and columns alone are not enough.
One diagonal adds to 1 + 7 + 4 = ___.
No; that diagonal totals 12, not 15.

harder.prompt_en: A number-game app shows a magic square with sum 75: 28 _ 26 / 23 25 27 / 24 29 22. What number replaces the blank?
harder.prompt_hi: Number-game app mein magic sum 75 wala square hai: 28 _ 26 / 23 25 27 / 24 29 22. Blank mein kaunsi sankhya aayegi?
hints: Which row holds the missing number?
Subtract its two known entries from the magic sum.
Missing number = 75 − 28 − 26 = ___.
21; the completed top row totals 75.

harder.prompt_en: A 3 × 3 magic square has magic sum 15. A game adds 7 points to every cell. Why is the new magic sum 36?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek 3 × 3 magic square ka magic sum 15 hai. Game har cell mein 7 points jodta hai. Naya magic sum 36 kyun hai?
harder.answer: Each line has three cells, so its sum increases by 3 × 7 = 21.
acceptable: Har line mein teen baar 7 judta hai
hints: How many entries change in one line?
The added points accumulate across each row, column and diagonal.
Increase in one line = ___ × 7.
Each line gains 21 because all three entries gain 7.

verified.solverAnswer: Each of the 3 rows adds 21 extra, so 15+21=36

openers.prompt_en: For a school percussion performance, S lasts 1 beat and L lasts 2 beats. How many different 5-beat rhythms start with L? Order matters.
openers.prompt_hi: School percussion performance mein S 1 beat aur L 2 beats ka hai. L se shuru hone wale 5-beat ke kitne alag rhythms hain? Order matter karta hai.
hints: After the first L, how many beats remain?
Count the possible rhythms for just those remaining beats.
Remove the first L; the remaining rhythms are ___, ___, and ___.
3 rhythms: LSSS, LSL, and LLS.

openers.prompt_en: In a music app, the numbers of rhythms for 4 and 5 beats are 5 and 8. A rhythm uses only 1-beat and 2-beat sounds. How many rhythms are possible for 6 beats?
openers.prompt_hi: Music app mein 4 aur 5 beats ke rhythms ki sankhya 5 aur 8 hai. Rhythm mein sirf 1-beat aur 2-beat sounds hain. 6 beats ke kitne rhythms honge?
hints: Which two earlier rhythm counts help find the next one?
A new count comes from adding the previous two counts.
For 6 beats, calculate ___ + ___.
13 rhythms: add the counts for 5 beats and 4 beats.

harder.prompt_en: For a cricket victory chant, S lasts 1 beat and L lasts 2 beats. How many different 7-beat rhythms contain exactly two L sounds? Order matters.
harder.prompt_hi: Cricket victory chant mein S 1 beat aur L 2 beats ka hai. Exactly do L sounds wale 7-beat ke kitne alag rhythms hain? Order matter karta hai.
hints: How many S sounds are needed alongside the two L sounds?
Count positions for the L sounds among all the sounds.
Choose two L positions from ___ total positions.
10 rhythms: choose two L positions among five sounds.

harder.prompt_en: A dance group counts 13 rhythms for 6 beats. Each next Virahanka count is the sum of the previous two; the 5-beat count is 8. How many rhythms are there for 9 beats?
harder.prompt_hi: Dance group ko 6 beats ke 13 rhythms milte hain. Har agla Virahanka count pichhle do counts ka sum hai; 5-beat count 8 hai. 9 beats ke kitne rhythms honge?
hints: Which count comes immediately after the 6-beat count?
Keep adding the two most recent counts.
Write the next counts in order: ___, ___, ___.
55 rhythms: the next counts are 21, 34, and 55.

harder.prompt_en: A metro jingle uses S (1 beat) and L (2 beats). Why is the number of 8-beat rhythms equal to the 7-beat count plus the 6-beat count? Answer using the first sound.
harder.prompt_hi: Metro jingle mein S (1 beat) aur L (2 beats) hain. 8-beat rhythms ki sankhya, 7-beat count aur 6-beat count ke sum ke barabar kyun hai? Pehle sound se samjhao.
harder.answer: Rhythms starting with S leave 7 beats; those starting with L leave 6 beats.
acceptable: Start with S and count 7 remaining beats, or start with L and count 6.
S leaves 7 beats and L leaves 6 beats.
S se shuru karo to 7 beats bachte hain; L se shuru karo to 6.
hints: What are the two possible first sounds?
Separate all rhythms by their first sound.
Starting with S leaves ___ beats; starting with L leaves ___ beats.
S leaves 7 beats; L leaves 6, so their counts add.

verified.solverAnswer: If first sound is S, rest is 7-beat; if L, rest is 6-beat

openers.prompt_en: At a school fair, two purchases cost ₹2□6 and ₹157. The total is ₹403. Which digit is hidden?
openers.prompt_hi: School fair mein do cheezon ki keemat ₹2□6 aur ₹157 hai. Total ₹403 hai. Kaunsa digit chhupa hai?
hints: What happens when you add the ones digits?
Carry from the ones column into the tens column.
In the tens column, □ + 5 + carry = ___.

openers.prompt_en: Two metro ticket codes follow this digit puzzle: A5 + A5 = 90. The letter A stands for the same digit both times. What is A?
openers.prompt_hi: Do metro ticket codes ka digit puzzle hai: A5 + A5 = 90. Dono jagah A ek hi digit hai. A kya hai?
hints: Does adding the ones digits create a carry?
Include that carry when you add the tens digits.
The tens column gives A + A + carry = ___.

harder.prompt_en: A shop bill shows ₹4□8 + ₹276 = ₹724. Find the hidden digit. Check the carry in both columns.
harder.prompt_hi: Ek shop bill par ₹4□8 + ₹276 = ₹724 likha hai. Chhupa digit dhoondo. Dono columns mein carry check karo.
hints: What does the ones column carry into the tens column?
Use that carry before solving the tens column.
The tens calculation is □ + 7 + carry = ___.

harder.prompt_en: In a number puzzle, AB + BA = 99. A and B are different nonzero digits, and A is 3 more than B. What are A and B?
harder.prompt_hi: Number puzzle mein AB + BA = 99 hai. A aur B alag, nonzero digits hain, aur A, B se 3 zyada hai. A aur B kya hain?
hints: What must the two ones digits add to?
Use the difference between the letters alongside their sum.
A + B = ___; A − B is given.

harder.prompt_en: Two three-digit cricket scores are added and the result has four digits. Why must its leading digit be 1 rather than 2? Give the limit that proves it.
harder.prompt_hi: Do three-digit cricket scores jodne par four-digit total aata hai. Uska pehla digit 2 ke bajay 1 hi kyun hoga? Sabit karne wali limit batao.
harder.answer: The greatest possible sum is 999 + 999 = 1,998, which is less than 2,000.
hints: How large can each three-digit score be?
Compare the greatest possible total with the next thousand.
The greatest possible total is ___ + ___.
999 + 999 = 1,998, below 2,000; its leading digit must be 1.

verified.solverAnswer: Maximum sum of two three-digit numbers is 1998, so leading digit cannot be 2.

ongrade.prompt_en: A school event collected ₹5□7 in one box and ₹268 in another. The total was ₹805. Which digit is hidden?
ongrade.prompt_hi: School event mein ek box se ₹5□7 aur doosre se ₹268 mile. Total ₹805 tha. Chhupa hua digit kya hai?
hints: What happens when you add the ones digits?
Use that carry when you work on the tens column.
3: the tens add to 10, carrying 1 to the hundreds.

ongrade.prompt_en: In the digit puzzle AB + BA = 143, A and B are different digits and A is 1 more than B. What two-digit number is AB?
ongrade.prompt_hi: Digit puzzle AB + BA = 143 mein A aur B alag digits hain, aur A, B se 1 zyada hai. AB kaunsi two-digit number hai?
hints: What does the ones column tell you about A + B?
The same sum appears in the tens column, with a carry.
A + B = ___; also, A is 1 more than B.

ongrade.prompt_en: In 8A7 + 2B6 = 11C3, each letter is a digit. What is the smallest possible value of A + B?
ongrade.prompt_hi: 8A7 + 2B6 = 11C3 mein har letter ek digit hai. A + B ki sabse chhoti possible value kya hai?
hints: Does the ones column send a carry to the tens column?
The hundreds column needs a carry from the tens column.
For a tens carry, A + B + 1 must be at least ___.
9: then the tens total is 10 and carries 1.

openers.prompt_en: For a school display, three rods are 6 cm, 9 cm and 14 cm long. Can they form a triangle?
openers.prompt_hi: School display ke liye teen rods 6 cm, 9 cm aur 14 cm ki hain. Kya inse triangle ban sakta hai?
hints: Which rod is the longest?
Compare the longest length with the other two added together.
The two shorter lengths add to ___; compare it with the longest.
Yes; the two shorter rods together are longer than the longest rod.

openers.prompt_en: To draw triangle ABC for a maths poster, draw AB = 8 cm first. AC must be 5 cm and BC must be 6 cm. What compass radius should you use for the arc centred at A?
openers.prompt_hi: Maths poster ke liye triangle ABC banao. Pehle AB = 8 cm banao; AC = 5 cm aur BC = 6 cm chahiye. A se arc banane ke liye compass kitna kholo?
hints: Which required side starts at A?
An arc centred at A marks points at that side’s distance.
Set the compass to the length of ___ before drawing A’s arc.
5 cm; the arc from A locates possible positions for C.

harder.prompt_en: A model bridge has supports of 1.2 m, 2.8 m and 4 m. Why can’t these form a triangular frame, even though the two shorter supports reach across the longest one?
harder.prompt_hi: Model bridge ke supports 1.2 m, 2.8 m aur 4 m ke hain. Chhote dono milkar sabse lambe support jitne hote hue bhi triangular frame kyun nahi banega?
harder.answer: The two shorter sides add up to exactly the longest side, making a straight line.
acceptable: their sum equals the longest side
triangle ke bajay seedhi line banegi
hints: What happens when the shorter supports are placed end to end?
A triangle needs the shorter lengths’ sum to exceed the longest.
Here that sum is ___ the longest length.
They form a straight line; their sum equals the longest side.

verified.solverAnswer: 1.2 + 2.8 = 4.0, equal to longest side, not greater.

harder.prompt_en: You draw a 9 cm base for a triangular team badge. From its endpoints, you draw arcs of radius 7 cm and 8 cm on both sides of the base. How many intersection points can mark the third vertex?
harder.prompt_hi: Team badge ke triangle ka 9 cm base banao. Uske dono endpoints se 7 cm aur 8 cm radius ke arcs base ke dono taraf banao. Teesra vertex kitne intersection points par ho sakta hai?
hints: Could the third vertex lie on either side of the base?
Each valid arc crossing gives a position for that vertex.
Count one crossing above and ___ below the base.
2; the arcs meet once on each side of the base.

harder.prompt_en: Two sides of a triangular stage frame are 8 m and 13 m. If the third side must be a whole number of metres, how many lengths are possible?
harder.prompt_hi: Triangular stage frame ki do sides 8 m aur 13 m hain. Agar teesri side poore metres mein honi chahiye, to kitni lengths possible hain?
hints: What lower and upper limits must the third side stay between?
Use the difference and sum of the known sides as strict limits.
List the whole numbers strictly between those limits, then count: ___.
15; the possible whole-number lengths run from 6 m through 20 m.

openers.prompt_en: On a triangular school banner ABC, D is the midpoint of BC. A line from A meets BC at E at a right angle. Which segment is the altitude from A: AD or AE?
openers.prompt_hi: Triangular school banner ABC mein D, BC ka midpoint hai. A se ek line BC ko E par right angle par milti hai. A se altitude kaunsa hai: AD ya AE?
hints: Which property defines an altitude?
Check where the line meets the opposite side at a right angle.
The segment with a right-angle meeting is ___.
AE; it meets BC at a right angle.

openers.prompt_en: A triangular cycle ramp PQR has a right angle at Q. To draw the altitude from P to side QR, which existing segment can you use: PQ or PR?
openers.prompt_hi: Triangular cycle ramp PQR mein Q par right angle hai. P se side QR par altitude draw karne ke liye kaunsa existing segment use karoge: PQ ya PR?
hints: Which segment from P reaches the named side?
Use the right angle already marked at Q.
The segment perpendicular to QR is ___.
PQ; it meets QR at the right angle at Q.

harder.prompt_en: In triangle ABC, angle B is 120°. To mark the altitude from A, extend side BC if needed. Will its perpendicular foot lie on BC, beyond B, or beyond C?
harder.prompt_hi: Triangle ABC mein angle B 120° hai. A se altitude banane ke liye zaroorat ho toh BC extend karo. Perpendicular ka foot BC par, B ke aage, ya C ke aage hoga?
hints: At which vertex is the wide angle?
A perpendicular from A needs the line containing BC.
Extend BC past ___ to meet that perpendicular.
Beyond B; the wide angle places the perpendicular foot outside that end.

harder.prompt_en: A triangular metro-route sketch ABC has an obtuse angle at B. Draw an altitude from each vertex to the opposite side or its extension. Which vertices have altitudes that fall outside the triangle?
harder.prompt_hi: Metro-route sketch ABC mein B par obtuse angle hai. Har vertex se opposite side ya uske extension par altitude banao. Kin vertices se bane altitudes triangle ke bahar padenge?
hints: Which altitude starts at the wide-angle vertex?
The other two perpendiculars may need extended sides.
The outside altitudes start from ___ and ___.
A and C; their perpendicular feet lie on extended sides.

verified.solverAnswer: vertices A and C (altitudes from A and C fall outside)

harder.prompt_en: A triangular school-event sign has area 840 cm² and a base of 48 cm. What is its altitude to that base, measured perpendicular to the base?
harder.prompt_hi: School-event ke triangular sign ka area 840 cm² aur base 48 cm hai. Us base par perpendicular naapne se altitude kitna hoga?
hints: How is a triangle’s area related to base and height?
Use the perpendicular height, not a sloping side.
Height = (2 × area) ÷ base = ___.
35 cm; twice the area divided by the base gives the altitude.

openers.prompt_en: A triangular stand for a school display has sides 7 cm, 7 cm and 10 cm. Its angles are 45°, 45° and 90°. Classify it by sides and by angles.
openers.prompt_hi: School display ke triangular stand ki sides 7 cm, 7 cm aur 10 cm hain. Angles 45°, 45° aur 90° hain. Sides aur angles, dono ke hisaab se classify karo.
hints: Which side lengths match? What is special about one angle?
Use one name for the sides and another for the angles.
Two equal sides mean ___; the special angle makes it ___.
Isosceles right triangle: two sides are equal and one angle is 90°.

openers.prompt_en: A triangular design on a cricket team’s badge has two angles of 65° and 75°. What is its third angle?
openers.prompt_hi: Cricket team ke badge par triangular design ke do angles 65° aur 75° hain. Teesra angle kitna hai?
hints: What total must the three angles reach?
Add the known angles, then subtract from the triangle’s angle sum.
40°: the other two angles add to 140°.

harder.prompt_en: A triangular kite has angles 50°, 50° and 80°, but its side lengths are not marked. Classify it by sides and by angles.
harder.prompt_hi: Ek triangular kite ke angles 50°, 50° aur 80° hain, lekin sides ki lengths nahi likhi hain. Sides aur angles, dono ke hisaab se classify karo.
hints: What can equal angles tell you about opposite sides?
Check every angle before choosing its angle-based name.
Equal angles imply ___ sides; all angles are ___.
Isosceles acute: equal angles face equal sides, and every angle is below 90°.

harder.prompt_en: A triangle in a game map has angles labelled 2x, 3x and 4x. What is its largest angle?
harder.prompt_hi: Game map ke ek triangle ke angles 2x, 3x aur 4x likhe hain. Sabse bada angle kitna hai?
hints: How many x parts are there altogether?
Set their total equal to a triangle’s angle sum.
2x + 3x + 4x = 180°; largest angle = 4 × ___ = ___.
80°: nine x parts make 180°, so x is 20°.

harder.prompt_en: Draw a line through a triangle’s top vertex parallel to its base. Which explains why its three angles add to 180°: alternate interior angles plus a straight angle, or vertically opposite angles plus a full turn?
harder.prompt_hi: Triangle ke top vertex se base ke parallel line kheecho. Teen angles ka sum 180° kyun hai: alternate interior angles aur straight angle ki wajah se, ya vertically opposite angles aur full turn ki wajah se?
harder.answer: Alternate interior angles plus a straight angle
acceptable: alternate angles and a straight line
alternate interior angles and straight angle
hints: Where do the base angles appear on the new line?
Compare angles made where each side crosses the parallel lines.
The matching angles sit beside the top angle, forming ___.
Alternate interior angles match the base angles; together they form a straight angle.

verified.solverAnswer: alternate interior angles plus a straight angle

openers.prompt_en: A school debate gets 40 minutes. Riya’s team uses 3/5 of that time. How many minutes do they use?
openers.prompt_hi: School debate ke liye 40 minute hain. Riya ki team us samay ka 3/5 use karti hai. Woh kitne minute use karti hai?
hints: How could you find one-fifth of the time?
Divide the total time into five equal parts, then take three.
24 minutes: three equal fifths of 40.

openers.prompt_en: A poster is shaded across 2/3 of its width and 1/4 of its height. What fraction of the whole poster is shaded in both directions?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek poster ki width ka 2/3 aur height ka 1/4 shade kiya gaya hai. Dono directions mein shaded hissa poore poster ka kaunsa fraction hai?
hints: Where would the two shaded regions overlap?
Use a grid with width and height split separately.
Overlapping fraction = (2 × 1)/(3 × 4) = ___.
1/6: two of twelve equal grid parts overlap.

harder.prompt_en: A school fair has 120 tickets. Class 7 gets 3/4 of them, then sells 2/3 of its share. How many tickets does Class 7 sell?
harder.prompt_hi: School fair ke 120 tickets hain. Class 7 ko unka 3/4 milta hai, phir woh apne hisse ka 2/3 bechti hai. Class 7 kitne tickets bechti hai?
hints: Whose share does the second fraction describe?
Find the class’s share before finding the part sold.
60 tickets: apply both fractions in order.

harder.prompt_en: A rectangular rangoli is divided into 4 columns and 5 rows. Three columns and two rows are marked. What fraction of the whole rangoli lies in both marked regions?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek rectangular rangoli ko 4 columns aur 5 rows mein baanta gaya hai. Teen columns aur do rows mark ki gayi hain. Poori rangoli ka kaunsa fraction dono marked regions mein aata hai?
hints: How many small rectangles lie in both marked regions?
Compare the overlap with every rectangle in the grid.
Overlap fraction = (3 × 2)/(4 × 5) = ___.
3/10: six of twenty rectangles overlap.

harder.prompt_en: A game multiplies your 42 points by 7/6. Will your new score be bigger or smaller than 42? Give the reason using the multiplier.
harder.prompt_hi: Ek game mein tumhare 42 points ko 7/6 se multiply kiya jaata hai. Naya score 42 se bada hoga ya chhota? Multiplier se wajah batao.
acceptable: Bada, kyunki 7/6 ek se zyada hai
hints: How does the multiplier compare with one whole?
A multiplier’s size relative to one predicts the direction.
7/6 is ___ than 1, so the score becomes ___.
Bigger: 7/6 is greater than 1.

openers.prompt_en: A school science display uses 1/6 metre of wire for each circuit. How many circuits can be made with 2 metres of wire?
openers.prompt_hi: School science display mein har circuit ke liye 1/6 metre wire lagta hai. 2 metre wire se kitne circuits banenge?
hints: How many circuit-lengths fit into one metre?
Count the sixth-metre lengths, then use both metres.
Number of circuits = 2 ÷ 1/6 = __.
12 circuits: six fit in each metre, and there are two metres.

openers.prompt_en: A video uses 3/8 GB of data. You have 3/4 GB left on your phone. How many such videos can you watch?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek video 3/8 GB data use karta hai. Tumhare phone par 3/4 GB data bacha hai. Aise kitne videos dekh sakte ho?
hints: What calculation compares the data left with data per video?
Divide the available data by the data for one video.
2 videos: multiply 3/4 by the reciprocal of 3/8.

harder.prompt_en: For a school event, each wristband needs 1/12 metre of thread. How many complete wristbands can be made from 9 metres of thread?
harder.prompt_hi: School event ke liye har wristband mein 1/12 metre dhaaga lagta hai. 9 metre dhaage se kitne poore wristbands banenge?
hints: How many wristband-lengths fit into each metre?
Count the twelfth-metre lengths across all nine metres.
Number of wristbands = 9 ÷ 1/12 = __.
108 wristbands: each metre supplies twelve wristband-lengths.

harder.prompt_en: A metro card has ₹2 1/4 of promotional credit. Each short trip uses ₹3/8 of this credit. How many trips can it cover?
harder.prompt_hi: Metro card par ₹2 1/4 ka promotional credit hai. Har short trip mein is credit ke ₹3/8 lagte hain. Isse kitni trips cover hongi?
hints: Which amount is divided by the cost per trip?
Convert the mixed number, then multiply by the divisor’s reciprocal.
6 trips: 9/4 multiplied by 8/3 equals 6.

harder.prompt_en: A cricket practice lasts 5/6 hour. Why is 5/6 ÷ 2/3 greater than 5/6? Answer using the reciprocal.
harder.prompt_hi: Cricket practice 5/6 ghanta chalti hai. 5/6 ÷ 2/3, 5/6 se bada kyun hai? Reciprocal se samjhao.
harder.answer: The reciprocal of 2/3 is 3/2, which is greater than 1, so multiplying 5/6 by it increases the value.
acceptable: Dividing by 2/3 means multiplying by 3/2, which makes the positive number bigger.
The divisor's reciprocal is greater than 1, so the answer increases.
hints: What multiplication replaces division by a fraction?
Compare the divisor’s reciprocal with one.
5/6 ÷ 2/3 = 5/6 × __; that factor is greater than one.
The reciprocal is 3/2; multiplying by this factor increases 5/6.

openers.prompt_en: At a school fair, Class 7 raised 2/5 of the total collection. Half of Class 7’s collection came from game stalls. To find the game stalls’ share of the total, should you multiply or subtract the fractions?
openers.prompt_hi: School fair mein Class 7 ne total collection ka 2/5 jutaaya. Class 7 ke collection ka aadha game stalls se aaya. Total mein game stalls ka hissa nikaalne ke liye fractions multiply karoge ya subtract?
hints: Is the question asking for a part of another part?
Think about what “half of Class 7’s collection” means.
To find a fraction of another fraction, ___ them.
Multiply: the stalls contributed half of Class 7’s share.

openers.prompt_en: A school club has ₹360. It spends 1/3 on posters, then 1/4 of the remaining money on tape. How much does it spend on tape?
openers.prompt_hi: School club ke paas ₹360 hain. Woh 1/3 posters par kharch karta hai, phir bache hue paison ka 1/4 tape par. Tape par kitne rupaye kharch hue?
hints: Which amount is the tape fraction taken from?
Find the money left after buying posters first.
Money left = ₹360 − ___; then take one-fourth.
₹60: posters cost ₹120, leaving ₹240; one-fourth is ₹60.

harder.prompt_en: A cricket team scores 2/5 of its runs in the powerplay and 1/3 of the remaining runs in the middle overs. Which expression gives the middle-overs share of all runs: (2/5) × (1/3) or (1 − 2/5) × (1/3)?
harder.prompt_hi: Cricket team powerplay mein total runs ka 2/5 aur middle overs mein bache runs ka 1/3 banati hai. Middle overs ka total runs mein hissa kaunsa expression dega: (2/5) × (1/3) ya (1 − 2/5) × (1/3)?
hints: Does “remaining runs” include the powerplay runs?
First express the share scored after the powerplay.
Middle-overs share = (1 − ___) × (1/3).
(1 − 2/5) × (1/3): the middle-overs fraction applies to the remainder.

harder.prompt_en: A school orders 960 badges. It gives 3/8 to volunteers, then 2/5 of the remaining badges to players. How many badges do the players get?
harder.prompt_hi: School 960 badges mangata hai. Volunteers ko 3/8 deta hai, phir bache hue badges ka 2/5 players ko deta hai. Players ko kitne badges milte hain?
hints: Are the players’ badges taken from the full order?
Work out what remains after the volunteers receive theirs.
Players’ badges = (960 − ___) × 2/5.
240 badges: 360 go to volunteers, leaving 600; two-fifths is 240.

harder.prompt_en: A 2/3-litre bottle is 3/4 full. Which reported amount makes sense: 1/2 litre, 3/4 litre, or 1/2 kg?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek bottle ki capacity 2/3 litre hai aur woh 3/4 bhari hai. Kaunsa bataya gaya amount sahi lagta hai: 1/2 litre, 3/4 litre, ya 1/2 kg?
hints: Can the water exceed the bottle’s capacity?
The unit must measure volume; multiply fullness by capacity.
Amount = 3/4 × 2/3 = ___ litre.
1/2 litre: it is below capacity and has the correct unit.

openers.prompt_en: For a school display, Asha cuts a 4 cm × 7 cm rectangle. Dev cuts a 7 cm × 4 cm rectangle. If Asha places her cut-out over Dev’s, can their edges match exactly?
openers.prompt_hi: School display ke liye Asha 4 cm × 7 cm ka rectangle kaat-ti hai. Dev 7 cm × 4 cm ka rectangle kaat-ta hai. Asha apna cut-out Dev ke upar rakhe, toh kya edges bilkul match ho sakte hain?
hints: Could Asha change how she holds her cut-out?
Compare which lengths form the two pairs of edges.
After placing them suitably, the edges ___.
Yes; turning one lets all its edges match.

openers.prompt_en: Two paper badges have the same outline, including a notch on one side. One badge is the mirror image of the other. Can you make them match exactly by flipping one badge?
openers.prompt_hi: Do paper badges ka outline same hai, aur ek side par notch bhi hai. Ek badge doosre ki mirror image hai. Kya ek badge ko flip karke dono bilkul match kar sakte hain?
hints: What happens to the notch when you turn the paper over?
A flip changes which way an outline faces.
After flipping one badge, the outlines ___.
Yes; flipping aligns the mirrored outlines exactly.

harder.prompt_en: Two phone-screen protectors are rectangles: one is 6 cm × 10 cm, the other 5 cm × 12 cm. Both have area 60 cm². If placed one over the other, can their edges match exactly? Answer yes or no.
harder.prompt_hi: Do phone-screen protectors rectangles hain: ek 6 cm × 10 cm aur doosra 5 cm × 12 cm. Dono ka area 60 cm² hai. Ek ko doosre par rakhein, toh kya edges bilkul match hongi? Haan ya nahi?
hints: Is equal area enough for every edge to line up?
Compare the side lengths, not just the areas.
The corresponding side lengths are ___, so the edges cannot align.
No; their side lengths differ despite equal areas.

harder.prompt_en: A logo is printed on a transparent sheet. Its reflection is printed on another sheet at the same size. Why can the two logos be congruent even though their notches point in opposite directions?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek transparent sheet par logo print hai. Doosri sheet par uska reflection same size mein print hai. Notches opposite directions mein hain, phir bhi logos congruent kyun ho sakte hain?
harder.answer: Flipping one sheet makes the outlines match without changing their shape or size.
acceptable: flip karne par dono match karte hain
a flip preserves shape and size
turn one sheet over to make them overlap exactly
hints: What can you do with a transparent sheet?
Think about which side of the sheet faces up.
Turning one sheet over makes the outlines ___.
Flipping makes them match; it does not change shape or size.

verified.solverAnswer: Reflections preserve size and shape, so they are congruent.

harder.prompt_en: Two triangular panels are congruent, with ΔKLM ≅ ΔTRS. In the first panel, KM is 12 cm. Which side of the second panel matches KM, and how long is it?
harder.prompt_hi: Do triangular panels congruent hain, aur ΔKLM ≅ ΔTRS. Pehle panel mein KM 12 cm hai. Doosre panel ki kaunsi side KM se match karti hai, aur uski length kya hai?
hints: Which vertices occupy the same positions in the two names?
Match the endpoints of the known side in order.
K matches ___, and M matches ___; use those endpoints.
TS is 12 cm; corresponding sides of congruent triangles are equal.

openers.prompt_en: Two triangular signboards have sides of 8 cm and 11 cm meeting at a 50° angle. Must the signboards have the same shape and size? Name the congruence rule.
openers.prompt_hi: Do triangular signboards mein 8 cm aur 11 cm ki sides 50° ke angle par milti hain. Kya dono ka shape aur size same hoga? Congruence rule batao.
hints: Where is the given angle compared with the two sides?
Check whether the angle lies between the measured sides.
The matching measurements follow side–___–side.
Yes, by SAS: the included angle and both sides match.

verified.solverAnswer: No, because only SAS is given but the third sides could differ; SAS congruence rule.

openers.prompt_en: Two triangular metro-map symbols each have a right angle, a 10 cm hypotenuse and a 6 cm side. Must they be congruent? Name the rule.
openers.prompt_hi: Do triangular metro-map symbols mein har ek ka right angle, 10 cm hypotenuse aur 6 cm ki ek side hai. Kya ye congruent honge? Rule batao.
hints: What special kind of triangles are these?
Use the hypotenuse and one matching side.
The rule combines a right angle, hypotenuse and ___.
Yes, by RHS: the right angle, hypotenuse and one side match.

verified.solverAnswer: Yes, they must be congruent by the RHS congruence rule.

harder.prompt_en: For two triangular stage panels, AB = PQ = 9 cm, BC = QR = 12 cm, and CA = RP = 15 cm. Which is correct: ΔABC ≅ ΔPQR or ΔABC ≅ ΔPRQ?
harder.prompt_hi: Do triangular stage panels mein AB = PQ = 9 cm, BC = QR = 12 cm, aur CA = RP = 15 cm. Kaunsa sahi hai: ΔABC ≅ ΔPQR ya ΔABC ≅ ΔPRQ?
acceptable: triangle ABC is congruent to triangle PQR
hints: Which vertices join the matching pairs of sides?
Match each vertex using the two sides that meet there.
A matches ___; then check the remaining vertices.
ΔABC ≅ ΔPQR: all three corresponding sides match.

harder.prompt_en: Two triangular school badges each have angles 45° and 65°, with an 8 cm side between those angles. A shop offers to make them from one template. Is that justified? Name the rule.
harder.prompt_hi: Do triangular school badges mein 45° aur 65° ke angles hain, aur unke beech ki side 8 cm hai. Shop ek hi template use karna chahti hai. Kya yeh sahi hai? Rule batao.
hints: Where is the measured side relative to the angles?
The side lies between two matching angles.
The measurements follow angle–___–angle.
Yes, by ASA: two angles and their included side match.

verified.solverAnswer: Yes, by the ASA congruence rule.

harder.prompt_en: Two students draw triangles using a 10 cm side, an 8 cm side, and a 30° angle opposite the 8 cm side. Why might their triangles not be congruent?
harder.prompt_hi: Do students 10 cm ki side, 8 cm ki side, aur 8 cm wali side ke saamne 30° ka angle lekar triangles banate hain. Unke triangles congruent kyun nahi bhi ho sakte?
harder.answer: SSA can give two different triangles because the angle is not between the given sides.
acceptable: the angle is not included, so two triangles are possible
hints: Is the angle between the two given sides?
Consider where the unfixed end of a side could meet.
This information may allow ___ different triangles.
SSA may give two triangles: the angle is not between the sides.

verified.solverAnswer: Because the given measurements correspond to SSA, which does not guarantee congruence.

openers.prompt_en: A triangular display stand has vertices A at the top and B and C on the floor. Its supports AB and AC are equal. Which two angles of the stand must be equal?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek triangular display stand mein A upar hai, aur B aur C floor par hain. Supports AB aur AC barabar hain. Stand ke kaunse do angles barabar honge?
hints: Equal supports meet at which vertex?
Look for the angles opposite the equal sides.
AB ke opposite angle ___ hai; AC ke opposite angle ___ hai.
∠B and ∠C; base angles opposite equal sides are equal.

openers.prompt_en: A triangular phone stand has two equal sloping sides. The angle between them is 80°. What is each angle where a sloping side meets the base?
openers.prompt_hi: Ek triangular phone stand ki do sloping sides barabar hain. Unke beech ka angle 80° hai. Har sloping side aur base ke beech ka angle kitna hoga?
hints: How many angles remain after the top angle?
The remaining angles are equal and share the leftover angle sum.
50°; the two equal base angles share 100°.

harder.prompt_en: For a triangular stage frame ABC, measurements show ∠B = ∠C. A worker claims AB = BC. Is the worker correct? Answer yes or no, and name the sides that must be equal.
harder.prompt_hi: Triangular stage frame ABC mein ∠B = ∠C hai. Ek worker kehta hai AB = BC. Kya woh sahi hai? Haan ya nahin bolo, aur jo sides barabar honi chahiye unke naam batao.
acceptable: nahin, AB aur AC barabar hain
hints: Which side lies opposite each measured angle?
Equal angles have equal opposite sides.
∠B ke opposite ___; ∠C ke opposite ___.
No; AB = AC, the sides opposite ∠C and ∠B.

verified.solverAnswer: No, AB and AC must be equal.

harder.prompt_en: A triangular roof frame has two equal sloping sides. Each angle at the base is twice the angle at the top. What is the top angle?
harder.prompt_hi: Ek triangular roof frame ki do sloping sides barabar hain. Base ka har angle, upar wale angle ka dugna hai. Upar wala angle kitna hai?
hints: How many copies of the top angle make up all three angles?
Both base angles are equal; express each using the top angle.
Top angle x ho, toh x + ___ + ___ = 180°.
36°; the three angles total five copies of the top angle.

harder.prompt_en: In triangular frame ABC, AB = AC. D is the midpoint of BC, and AD is drawn. Why must ∠B equal ∠C? Name the congruence rule and what it tells you about these angles.
harder.prompt_hi: Triangular frame ABC mein AB = AC hai. D, BC ka midpoint hai, aur AD khincha gaya hai. ∠B aur ∠C barabar kyun honge? Congruence rule aur angles ke baare mein uska natija batao.
harder.answer: ΔABD ≅ ΔACD by SSS, so corresponding angles ∠B and ∠C are equal.
acceptable: SSS; corresponding base angles are equal
SSS se dono triangles congruent hain, isliye B aur C ke angles barabar hain
hints: Which two smaller triangles does AD form?
Compare their sides, including the shared side and midpoint segments.
